moral.zh: 夜里叶片辐射散热变冷，空气中的水汽在叶片上凝结成露珠。
moral.en: At night, cooling leaves can make water vapor in the air condense into tiny droplets of dew.

pages.zhText: 清晨，米米在花园里发现叶尖亮晶晶：“露珠是怎么来的？”
pages.enText: One morning, Mimi spotted sparkling drops on the leaves. “How does dew get there?”

pages.zhText: 它不是植物的眼泪，也通常不是天上落下的；低于冰点会成霜。
pages.enText: Dew is not a plant’s tears, and it usually does not fall from the sky. Below freezing, frost forms instead.
